Make Variant

Make a copy of {0} under a new name. The copy starts out identical. Fork the materials you want to recolour: the copy gets MATBINs of its own, so editing them leaves the original (and every other model using them) alone.
New Name
The asset name of the copy (aegXXX_YYY). It must not be used by any asset file or asset param row.
aegXXX_YYY: XXX is the group, YYY the number in it. The param row is XXX * 1000 + YYY.
Suggest
Fill in the next free name: in the original's group, or in the project group when that option is on.
Use Project Group
Suggest names in one group set aside for this project's variants (for example aeg900_*), well clear of the game's own assets, instead of the original's group.
The project group (0 to 999).
No free name was found in this group. Type a name in another group, or use the project group.
Files

The files written into the project: copies of the original's files, renamed inside (binder entries, the model's root bone, collision body names). Material paths change only for the materials forked below; texture paths are left as they are.
The files are written when you confirm. Undo in the Map Editor switches the parts back and undo in the Param Editor removes the rows, but the files stay in the project.
Materials

The original's materials (MATBINs). Shared: the copy uses the same MATBIN, so editing it changes the original too. Forked: the MATBIN is duplicated under a new name for the copy, and the copy's model names it.
The original's model names no materials.
Materials can't be forked: the Material Editor isn't loaded. Every material is shared.
Fork All
Give the copy its own copy of every material.
Share All
Let the copy use the original's materials.

Options
Copy Param Rows

Copy the original's AssetEnvironmentGeometryParam row {0}, and its rows in the params keyed by the asset (AssetModelSfxParam, SpeedtreeParam, AssetTranscriptionParam), under the copy's IDs. They are added in the Param Editor as one undoable edit and written when the params are saved.
Switch the {0} Selected Parts to the Copy
Switch the selected parts that use the original to the copy, as one undo step (with the Model Selector's name and instance ID options).
Make Variant
Write the copy's files into the project, then add the param rows and switch the parts.
Cancel
Close without making anything.

Save Params Now
Save the params now, as the Param Editor's Save does. This saves every unsaved param edit, not only these rows.
Save Materials Now
Save the materials now, as the Material Editor's Save does. This saves every unsaved material edit, not only the forked materials.
Save Params and Materials Now
Save the params and the materials now, as the Param Editor's and Material Editor's Save do. This saves every unsaved edit in both, not only the variant's rows and materials.
